style: Instrumental symphonic folk adventure, progressive bluegrass, Indian chamber fusion; relaxed 96 BPM in 4/4. Sarod introduces an original lyrical melody; mandolin answers with short rhythmic phrases, cello supplies an independent counterline, upright bass keeps a warm pocket. Dobro connects selected phrases with slow slides. Begin with the exposed sarod-mandolin duet. Develop their ideas in a small acoustic ensemble, then let French horns carry the expansion's main melody while divided strings support it quietly. Keep mandolin audible during its answers. Thin the texture to bass and dobro before a warm final reprise. Open fifths, modal warmth, suspended orchestral voicings, natural dynamic growth. Close wood and bow detail within a deep clear hall; acoustic soloists remain distinct. Companionable, adventurous and deeply melodic, ending with a quiet return to the opening idea.
